title: KPI/KRI catalog staleness
summary: Count of catalog entries that either fail content-model/metrics.schema.json validation or have not been re-attested by the catalog governance owner within the operator's pinned review cadence at the end of the rollup window. Surfaces silent erosion of the catalog itself — a malformed or unreviewed entry cannot be allowed to inflate or deflate the effectiveness score.

target.rationale: Catalog entries that fail validation or miss governance review must be excluded from the rollup until corrected.

measurement.formula: count(catalog entries where validation_state != 'valid' OR (window_end - last_governance_review_time) > governance.review_cadence).

inputs.name: governance
inputs.description: catalog governance attestations, schema-validation outcomes, and review-cadence pins

external_refs.name: NIST SP 800-53 PM-6 Measures of Performance
